title: Open restriction preserves the specified derived adjunction unit and counit
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $p:V\to Z$ be a morphism of schemes and $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ an open immersion. Form the cartesian square with $V_W=V\times_ZW$, $b:V_W\hookrightarrow V$ and $q:V_W\to W$ [def-cbc-open-immersion-square, def-pc-fibre-product]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Write $P_u\dashv S_u$ for exact inverse image and total derived direct image, with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$, and $J_j\dashv P_j$ for exact open extension. Let $\beta:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\sim}J_bP_q$ be the open-unit-normalized comparison of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and let $\theta:P_qP_i\xrightarrow{\sim}P_bP_p$ be canonical pullback composition. Let $E:P_iS_p\xrightarrow{\sim}S_qP_b$ be the open-restriction isomorphism, whose map on derived Hom sets is the chain
$$\operatorname{Hom}(H,P_iS_pG)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(J_iH,S_pG)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(P_pJ_iH,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(J_bP_qH,G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(P_qH,P_bG)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(H,S_qP_bG),$$
using $\beta^{-1}$ in the middle. Then $E$ agrees with ordinary open restriction of derived direct image, with the identity-on-sections normalization, and the following equations hold for every $F$ on $Z$ and $G$ on $V$:
$$E_{P_pF}\,P_i(\eta_{p,F})=S_q(\theta_F)\,\eta_{q,P_iF},$$
$$\varepsilon_{q,P_bG}\,P_q(E_G)=P_b(\varepsilon_{p,G})\,\theta_{S_pG}.$$
Composition is right to left. Both are equalities in the stated derived categories, natural in the inputs. No properness, quasi-compactness, constructibility, Tor or boundedness hypothesis is imposed.
